title: Le Grand full theoretical eye, accommodated
source: Y. Le Grand and S. G. El Hage, Physiological Optics (Springer, 1980); values as tabulated in J. Schwiegerling, 'Schematic Eyes and Ametropia', University of Arizona course notes. See models/le-grand-full-theoretical-eye.md.
notes: The source gives one set of indices and no wavelength; they are filed at 587.6 nm. The model has no dispersion: use one wavelength.
The stop (iris) is placed at the lens front surface.
The source gives no retina for the accommodated eye; the relaxed eye's retina (R = -13.4 mm) is used.
